title: Custom Locator Color
body:
# CustomLocatorColor

Tired of squinting at the locator bar trying to figure out which dot is which player? This mod lets you assign custom colors to players by name, so your friends always stand out exactly the way you want.

## Features

Set a custom locator bar color for any player by their username

Config screen via ModMenu

## How to use

Open mod config in ModMenu

Add a player name and pick a color

Done, their dot on the locator bar will use your chosen color

## Requirements

[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

[Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)

[ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
